# Mahila Vastra

> Premium Indian traditional wear boutique based in Bangalore, India. Exclusive in-house designed sarees, kurtis, and ethnic wear for women and children with Pan-India delivery.

## About

Mahila Vastra is an online ethnic wear boutique that designs exclusive traditional Indian clothing. Every piece is conceptualized by an in-house design studio and brought to life by trusted partner artisans and factories. The brand specializes in authentic, artisan-crafted sarees, kurta sets, kurtis, blouses, and kids' traditional wear.

## Collections

- [Saree Treasures](https://mahilavastra.in/#catalog): Signature Silks (Pure Kanjeevaram & Banarasi), Designer Couture (hand-embroidery), Festive & Pooja sarees, Daily Drapes (cotton & prints)
- [Ethnic Daily Wear](https://mahilavastra.in/#catalog): Premium Kurta Sets, Kurtas & Kurtis, Bottom Wear (palazzos, pants, leggings), Home Wear (cotton loungewear)
- [The Blouse Studio](https://mahilavastra.in/#catalog): Readymade Blouses, Designer Blouses, Cotton Blouses (Coming Soon)
- [Little Stars Kids Wear](https://mahilavastra.in/#catalog): Girls Traditional Wear, Girls Daily Wear, Smart Outing Wear, Kids Pooja Wear (Coming Soon)

## Key Differentiators

- 100% original in-house designs — not resold wholesale goods
- Direct artisan and factory partnerships — no middlemen
- Personally quality-controlled production
- Pan-India delivery to all states
- Assisted shopping experience via WhatsApp
- 7-day no-questions-asked return policy with full refund
- Cash on Delivery available (delivery charges paid in advance)

- **Operating Hours**: Mon-Sat, 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM IST
- **Price Range**: Mid-range to Premium
- **Return Policy**: 7-day return, full refund or exchange

- **Payment**: Online payment + Cash on Delivery
